verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents physical cards shipped worldwide and unlimited corporate cards 'everywhere your team operates,' which implies cards can be used for spending abroad. Its fee-free and competitive-FX claims cover transfers, wires, and cross-border payments, not card purchases. No evidence addresses foreign transaction fees on card spend or cash withdrawals. Missing for 10: any statement on card foreign-transaction/FX fees, ATM cash withdrawal support and fees, transparent card FX pricing, independent corroboration.
